plays.desc_ko: Dokla가 화약통을 맞히고 벽을 넘어 점멸한 뒤 또 한 번 화약통+Q로 Chovy를 거의 빈사로 만듦; 양측 점멸 교환. Chovy는 순간이동으로 귀환 후 복귀.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla lands a barrel, flashes over the wall and hits another barrel plus Parrrley to leave Chovy nearly dead; both sides trade Flashes and Chovy recalls then returns via Teleport.
plays.quote: it's Chovy who's been chunked down to ... flashes gone. He traded flashes there, ... Chovy's going to TP

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 체력이 절반일 때 Chovy가 복귀하고 위버의 벽으로 모두를 밀어낸 뒤 Ruler가 화염 드래곤을 확보—LYON은 또다시 영혼을 놓침.
plays.desc_en: With dragon at half, Chovy returns and pushes everyone away with Weaver's Wall, then Ruler secures the Infernal Drake as LYON misses soul again.
plays.quote: Weaver's wall zones everybody away. The ... infernal drake is GOING TO BE SECURED BY ... GEN.G AND RULER.

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤을 내준 직후 LYON이 체력이 낮은 GEN을 추격; Canyon은 애니비아 결정화를 점멸로 넘어 합류. Dokla의 후속 화약통은 빗나가고(회고에선 3인 적중 화약통 언급) GEN이 이탈—양측 킬 없음.
plays.desc_en: LYON chases low-health GEN after the dragon; Canyon flashes over Anivia's Crystallize to rejoin. Dhokla's follow-up barrel misses and GEN escapes with no kills on either side.
plays.quote: BUT LION ARE ON THE HUNT SEEING THE ... rest of the team. Follow up barrel ... on the infernal soul yet again. No kills

plays.desc_ko: Chovy가 위버의 벽을 타고 진입(Berserker에게 지각 변동은 빗나감), Kiin이 Inspired에게 큰 피해, 대폭발(Grand Starfall) 후 Ruler가 폭주; Saint가 알이 된 뒤 지각 변동이 애니비아를 묻어 Chovy 더블킬, Berserker도 사망—GEN 에이스. 해설은 Chovy의 벽이 교전을 만들었다고 정리.
plays.desc_en: Chovy rides Weaver's Wall in, missing Seismic Shove on Berserker, Kiin chunks Inspired and Ruler goes off after Grand Starfall; Saint eggs and Seismic Shove buries Anivia for Chovy's double kill, Berserker falls too and GEN aces. The casters credit Chovy's wall for making the fight.
plays.quote: It's Chovy rides in the Weavers ... and Ruler goes on A RAMPAGE. SAINT ... KILL BACK OVER TO CHOVY. BERSERKER'S
